newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Light plane crashes in New Zealand, six die.
newsitem.headline: Light plane crashes in New Zealand, six die.

text.p: Six people were killed when a light plane crashed on Friday at the base of the Remarkables mountain range near Queenstown, a police spokeswoman said.
She said the privately-hired Cessna 310 aircraft crashed shortly after takeoff from Queenstown, apparently bound for Nelson.

"It crashed shortly after takeoff from Queenstown airport into the base of the Remarkables," the spokeswoman said. "There were six people on the plane. There are no survivors. It's believed that all were New Zealanders."

A police team was working to identify the victims and awaiting the arrival of accident investigators. The cause was not immediately clear as the crash apparently occurred in fine conditions, the spokeswoman said.
